# Write docs and screenshots (/docs/developers/build/docs-and-screenshots)

## Declare what a page covers [#declare-what-a-page-covers]

Every page under `content/docs` and every key in `screenshots.json` has an entry in `docs/site-fumadocs/docs-covers.json`:

```json
"user/everyday-use/use-incognito": { "areas": ["incognito"] }
```

- `areas` names code groups defined once at the top of the file, each a list of globs.
- `covers` adds extra globs for one page (for example `docs/design/RULES.md`).
- `ignore` lists globs that never count as a change: tests, locales, docs.
- `baseline` is the commit the docs were last verified at, used until a `v*` tag exists.

## Check what changed [#check-what-changed]

```bash
bun scripts/docsDrift.ts
```

It lists the pages to re-check and the pictures to retake since the last release tag. `--since <ref>` picks another start, `--json` gives machine output, `--check` fails if a page or picture has no entry.

## Screenshots [#screenshots]

Pictures come only from the screenshot script. The drift output prints the `DOCS_SHOTS_ONLY=...` line that retakes just the affected docs pictures. A picture whose file does not start with `docs-` comes from the general screenshot run. Open every retaken picture before using it.

## Kept current by [#kept-current-by]

[Keeping the docs current](/docs/keeping-docs-current) explains the release step. The test `scripts/docsDrift.test.ts` fails if the map falls out of step with the pages.

# MaiPai Home documentation (/docs)

<Callout type="warn" title="Table of contents draft">Pick a guide on the left. Each page here is a plan. When you approve, I write them.</Callout>

# Keeping the docs current (/docs/keeping-docs-current)

## The idea in one line [#the-idea-in-one-line]

Docs are updated when you cut a release, never on a push, and only the pages and pictures whose code changed.

## How it works [#how-it-works]

- One file, `docs/site-fumadocs/docs-covers.json`, says which code each guide page and each screenshot describes.
- At release time `bun scripts/docsDrift.ts` compares the code changed since the last `v*` tag with that file. It prints the pages to re-check and the pictures to retake.
- The release step then updates only that list. Pictures from the docs run are retaken with `DOCS_SHOTS_ONLY`, so nothing else is regenerated.
- Edits to tests, locale files and the docs themselves never mark a page as changed.
- Before the first release tag exists, the window starts at the commit the docs were last verified against.

## What a contributor does [#what-a-contributor-does]

- A new page or picture gets its entry in `docs-covers.json` in the same commit. A test fails if one is missing or points at nothing.
- `bun scripts/docsDrift.ts --check` runs the same completeness check by hand.

## What this does not solve [#what-this-does-not-solve]

- A change in meaning that touches no listed file (a new rule). Someone still has to say "this affects the docs".
- Screenshots of a feature that has no demo data yet. The seeded household must gain that data first.
- Pages generated from code, and a hand-edit guard for them, are not part of this step.


# Ask it to look something up (/docs/user/everyday-use/ask-it-to-look-something-up)

MaiPai decides on its own when to look something up. You can also ask it to.

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Open a chat.
2. Type what you want to know, such as "Look up when the next train leaves."
3. Send the message.
4. Read the answer. Small numbers like [1] mark facts that came from a page.
5. Tap a number to see which page it came from.
6. Open **Sources** under the answer to see the whole list.

## 🔒 What gets sent [#-what-gets-sent]

A search sends only your search words, with no name or address. The Privacy page explains it. See [What stays in the house](/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/what-stays-in-the-house).

## 👶 For children and teens [#-for-children-and-teens]

Their searches follow the house settings, and what MaiPai reads is checked first.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If searching does nothing, an admin may have it off: see [Web search](/docs/admin/connect-and-extend/web-search). Or see [If chat does not answer](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/chat-does-not-answer).


# Find and share your files (/docs/user/everyday-use/find-and-share-your-files)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. In a chat, find a document MaiPai made. Tap the **More** button beside it.
2. Tap **Show in Library**. The **Library** opens.
3. Use **Search your Library**, **Whose** and **Kind** to find a file.
4. Tap **View details** on a row, or pick it under **Select a file**.

## 🤝 Share a file [#-share-a-file]

Under **Shared with**, pick a person or **The whole household**. Tap **Share**. To stop, tap **Unshare** beside the name.

You can only share files that are yours. A file shared with you shows under **Shared with me** in **Whose**.

## ⬇️ Keep a copy [#️-keep-a-copy]

In the file details, use the download button to save a copy.

If the Library is empty, it says "Nothing here yet. Stories, pictures and documents you make in chat are kept here."

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If a file you made is missing, ask the person who runs the house.


# Keep chats in a project (/docs/user/everyday-use/keep-chats-in-a-project)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. In **Chat**, find **Projects** in the chat list. Tap **See all projects**.
2. Tap **Create**.
3. In **Project settings**, type a **Project name**. Add a **Description** and **Instructions** if you like.
4. Tap **Save**.
5. Tap the project's name to open it and chat inside it.

## 🔍 Find and change one [#-find-and-change-one]

Type in **Search projects** to narrow the list. Tap the pencil to change a project. If it is yours, you can also pin it, or tap **Delete project**. Deleting a project keeps its chats.

**Instructions** shape the answers in that project.

## 👨‍👩‍👧 Good to know [#-good-to-know]

Children cannot create projects. The page is hidden while Incognito is on.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If the **Create** button is missing, you may be signed in as a child. Ask the person who runs the house.


# Make it easier to read (/docs/user/everyday-use/make-it-easier-to-read)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Tap **Settings**, then **Appearance**.
2. Find the **Ease of use** card.
3. Under **Comfort style**, pick one:
   - **Standard**: MaiPai as it comes.
   - **Comfortable**: bigger words and more room.
   - **Large**: bigger words and buttons, stronger contrast.
   - **Simple**: bigger buttons, calm colors and helpers.
4. Watch the page change right away.

## 🎚️ Change one thing [#️-change-one-thing]

Each row on the card changes one setting, like text size or motion. A row set to **Preset** follows your style. Change one row and the rest keep following.

After you change a row you see a line like "Large + 2 changes". Tap **Back to Large** to undo them.

## 🔒 A greyed-out row [#-a-greyed-out-row]

If an admin set a row for you, it is greyed out and says so. Ask them if you want it changed.

<Callout type="info">These choices change comfort only. They never change what is safe or allowed.</Callout>

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If a change will not save, see [If a setting will not save](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/a-setting-will-not-save).


# Rate or fix a reply (/docs/user/everyday-use/rate-or-fix-a-reply)

Every reply has a row of small buttons under it.

## 🔘 What the buttons do [#-what-the-buttons-do]

- **Copy**: copies the reply.
- **Read aloud**: reads it to you.
- **Helpful**: tells MaiPai the answer was good.
- **Not helpful**: opens a short form.
- **Refresh**: asks for a new answer.
- **More**: more choices. Adults and teens can pick **Remember this** to keep a fact.

## ✍️ Steps to say what went wrong [#️-steps-to-say-what-went-wrong]

1. Tap **Not helpful** under the reply.
2. Under **What went wrong?**, pick one or more: Wrong, Too long, Didn't listen, Off topic, or Unsafe.
3. Add a short note if you like. It is optional.
4. Tap **Send feedback**.

Children rate with the thumbs only. To take back a rating, tap the lit thumb again.

## 🔁 Try again [#-try-again]

Tap **Refresh** to get a new answer to the same question.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If a reply never arrives, see [If chat does not answer](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/chat-does-not-answer). If an answer worried you, tell a grown-up in the house.


# See what it remembered (/docs/user/everyday-use/see-what-it-remembered)

MaiPai remembers things that help it answer you, such as a favorite food. You can see them and remove them.

## ✍️ Steps to see them [#️-steps-to-see-them]

1. Tap **Family** in the main menu.
2. Tap your own card.
3. Tap the **Memories** tab.

<Shot id="memory" />

If it says "Nothing remembered yet.", there is nothing stored.

## 🗑️ Forget one [#️-forget-one]

Tap the archive-box button beside a memory. It is removed from what MaiPai uses.

## 🗑️ Forget several [#️-forget-several]

1. Tap **Select memories**.
2. Tick the ones to remove.
3. Tap **Forget selected**, then confirm. Or tap **Clear all** to remove every one.

Forgetting cannot be undone. Choose **Keep them** if you change your mind.

## 👥 Who may hear a memory [#-who-may-hear-a-memory]

Adults can choose who a memory may be shared with: everyone, teens and adults, or adults only.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

To erase more than memories, see [Forget something](/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/forget-something). If this page will not load, see [If a page will not load](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/page-will-not-load).


# See your notifications (/docs/user/everyday-use/see-your-notifications)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Tap the bell, or open your profile menu and tap **Notifications**. A small list of new notices opens.
2. Tap **Dismiss** beside a notice to clear it, or **Dismiss all** to clear the list.
3. Tap **View history** to see older ones.
4. On the history page, tap **Select**, choose some, then tap **Dismiss selected**. Or tap **Clear all**.

<Shot id="notifications" />

<Shot id="notifications-history" />

History goes back 30 days. A notice you cleared shows a **Dismissed** badge. One you opened shows **Read**. If nothing came in, you see "Nothing in the last 30 days."

## 👨‍👩‍👧 If you are a parent [#-if-you-are-a-parent]

You also get a note when a child had a conversation that seemed to weigh on them. It carries the child's name only, never what was said. It cannot be turned off.

## 📨 Notices elsewhere [#-notices-elsewhere]

An admin can also send notices to Telegram. See [Notifications and Telegram](/docs/admin/connect-and-extend/notifications-and-telegram).

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If the bell stays empty and you expected a notice, ask the person who runs the house.


# Send a message (/docs/user/everyday-use/send-a-message)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Tap **Chat** in the main menu.
2. Tap **New chat** to start fresh, or tap an older chat in the list to keep going.
3. Click the box that says **Send a message...**
4. Type your question.
5. Press Enter, or tap **Send message**.
6. Read the answer as it appears.
7. If you scrolled up, tap **Scroll to bottom** to jump to the newest text.

## 📎 Adding a file [#-adding-a-file]

Tap the **+** button (**Add Attachment**) next to the box to add a file or picture to your message.

## 🔎 Find an old chat [#-find-an-old-chat]

Tap **Search chats** and type a word from the chat you want.

## 🏷️ Rename or delete a chat [#️-rename-or-delete-a-chat]

Open the chat, then tap the menu at the top, called **Conversation actions**. Pick **Rename** or **Delete**. For more on deleting, see [Forget something](/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/forget-something).

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If no answer comes, see [If chat does not answer](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/chat-does-not-answer).


# Talk instead of type (/docs/user/everyday-use/talk-instead-of-type)

## ✍️ Steps to talk [#️-steps-to-talk]

1. Open a chat.
2. Tap the microphone button (**Voice input**) in the message box.
3. If your browser asks to use the microphone, choose to allow it. MaiPai cannot hear you until you do.
4. Say your question.
5. Tap **Stop dictation** when you finish. Your words appear in the box.
6. Check them, then send the message.

## 🔊 Hear an answer [#-hear-an-answer]

Under a reply, tap **Read aloud**. Tap **Stop reading** to quiet it. In the menu at the top, called **Conversation actions**, **Read replies aloud** reads every reply. You see it only when your house has a voice set up.

## 🎙️ Wake word [#️-wake-word]

On a computer where the wake word files are installed, owners, admins and adults can turn on wake word listening so they do not have to tap. Teens, children and guests do not get it. It is off until you turn it on.

1. In a chat, tap the microphone button in the message box that says **Turn on wake word listening**. You do not see it if the files are not installed.
2. Allow the microphone if your browser asks.
3. Say "Hey Jarvis". That is the only wake word today, and you cannot change it. The voice conversation opens.
4. To stop, tap **Turn off wake word listening** in the red bar that says "Listening for Hey Jarvis".

The setting belongs to this device, not to you. Listening is paused while a voice conversation is open and stops when you close the page.

<Callout type="info">The microphone works only while the page is open and you have allowed it.</Callout>

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If it cannot hear you, see [If voice does not work](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/voice-does-not-work). An admin can set up voices: see [Settings reference](/docs/admin/install-and-set-up/settings-reference).


# Use Incognito (/docs/user/everyday-use/use-incognito)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Tap your picture at the bottom of the left rail. The profile menu opens.
2. Tap **Incognito**. It shows **On**, and your picture gets a purple ring.
3. A box called "What Incognito does" appears the first time. Tap **Got it**.
4. Chat as usual.
5. To finish, open the profile menu and tap **Incognito** again. It shows **Off**.

## 🕶️ What it does [#️-what-it-does]

Incognito turns off memory and personalization across MaiPai. What you do while it is on stays out of your history. When you turn it off, those chats are forgotten.

What is kept: nothing is saved to your history or memories. MaiPai holds the chat in the hub's working memory only, so it can follow the conversation while you talk. That copy is dropped when you turn Incognito off, after the chat has sat idle for two hours, or when the hub restarts. It does not keep a turn trace either.

Incognito belongs to the tab you are in. A new tab starts with it off. While it is on, the **Projects** page sends you back to chat.

## 👨‍👩‍👧 Who can use it [#-who-can-use-it]

Incognito chats are for owners, admins and adults. Teens, children and guests do not get Incognito chats. The **Incognito** item may still show in their profile menu, but the hub refuses to start a private chat for them, so nothing is turned on for them.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If Incognito does not start a chat, check your role in [What each role can do](/docs/user/your-family/what-each-role-can-do). Ask the person who runs the house to change it.


# If a setting will not save (/docs/user/fix-a-problem/a-setting-will-not-save)

## 🔒 A lock means an admin controls this one [#-a-lock-means-an-admin-controls-this-one]

A greyed-out or locked setting was set by an admin. You cannot change it. The row says who to ask.

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Look for a lock or a grey row next to the setting.
2. If you see one, ask an admin to change it or unlock it for you.
3. If there is no lock, reload the page and try again.
4. Check that you are on the right page. Your own settings are under **Settings**.
5. If it still snaps back, check for a message near the setting and follow it.

## 🎚️ Comfort settings [#️-comfort-settings]

For text size and motion, a row set to **Preset** follows your style. Pick a different **Comfort style** or change the single row. See [Make it easier to read](/docs/user/everyday-use/make-it-easier-to-read).

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Admins, see [Settings reference](/docs/admin/install-and-set-up/settings-reference). Others, see [Still stuck](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck).


# If you cannot sign in (/docs/user/fix-a-problem/cannot-sign-in)

<Shot id="sign-in-wrong-pin" />

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Make sure you picked your own name from the list.
2. Type your 4 digits again under **Enter your PIN**.
3. If your sign-in is a longer password, tap **Use a password instead**. Type it in **Password** and tap **Sign in**.
4. To go back to digits, tap **Use a PIN instead**. To pick a different name, tap **Back**.
5. If it still fails, ask an admin to reset your PIN.

After a wrong PIN you see a tip about using a longer password. That tip is a hint, not a lock.

## 🆕 A brand new install [#-a-brand-new-install]

If nobody has been added yet, MaiPai opens its setup instead. Ask the person who installed it.

## 🔐 Teens, children and guests [#-teens-children-and-guests]

You may not need a PIN at all. Adults, admins and owners always do.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Admins, see [First-run setup](/docs/admin/install-and-set-up/first-run-setup). Others, see [Still stuck](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck).


# If chat does not answer (/docs/user/fix-a-problem/chat-does-not-answer)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Wait a minute. The first answer after a restart can be slow, and you may see **Starting your AI…**.
2. If an error shows, tap **Retry**.
3. Reload the page and send the message again.
4. Open **Home** and look at the **Repairs** card. A number means something needs fixing.
5. Open **Repairs**. Each row says what is wrong and how to fix it.

<Shot id="repairs" />

6. If a repair needs an admin, tell the person who runs the house.

Admins also see **Error details** on a failed answer. Send those to whoever helps with the house.

## 🔁 Try a fresh start [#-try-a-fresh-start]

Tap **New chat** and ask something short. If that works, the old chat may be the problem.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Admins, see [Troubleshooting and support report](/docs/admin/look-after-it/troubleshooting-and-support-report). Others, see [Still stuck](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck).


# If a page will not load (/docs/user/fix-a-problem/page-will-not-load)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Check that your phone or computer is on your home Wi-Fi.
2. Reload the page.
3. Close the tab and open MaiPai Home again with the address the person who runs the house gave you.
4. Try a different browser.
5. If you see "Could not reach the hub.", the computer that runs MaiPai may be off or restarting. Wait a few minutes and try again.
6. Ask the person who runs the house to check that the computer is on.

<Callout type="info">Away from home, MaiPai only opens if an admin set up remote access.</Callout>

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Admins, see [Remote access](/docs/admin/connect-and-extend/remote-access) and [Troubleshooting and support report](/docs/admin/look-after-it/troubleshooting-and-support-report). Others, see [Still stuck](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck).


# Still stuck (/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Write down what you were doing and what you saw. Include the words on any message.
2. Tell the person who runs the house. They are the owner or an admin.
3. Tell them the time it happened and whether it happens every time.

## 🧰 For the person who runs the house [#-for-the-person-who-runs-the-house]

Admins can build a support report to share when asking for help. See [Troubleshooting and support report](/docs/admin/look-after-it/troubleshooting-and-support-report).

Other useful pages:

- [Updates and rollback](/docs/admin/look-after-it/updates-and-rollback)
- [Backups and restore](/docs/admin/look-after-it/backups-and-restore)
- [Where your data lives](/docs/admin/how-it-works/where-your-data-lives)

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Open the [Admin guide](/docs/admin/) and read the troubleshooting page. If you run the house, it covers the next steps.


# If voice does not work (/docs/user/fix-a-problem/voice-does-not-work)

## 🎤 It cannot hear you [#-it-cannot-hear-you]

1. Tap the microphone button (**Voice input**).
2. When your browser asks to use the microphone, choose to allow it.
3. If you said no before, open your browser's site settings for MaiPai Home and allow the microphone there.
4. Say your question, then tap **Stop dictation**.

## 🔊 It will not speak [#-it-will-not-speak]

1. Look for **Read aloud** under a reply. If you do not see it, your house has no voice set up yet.
2. Turn up your device volume.
3. Tap **Read aloud** again.

## 👂 The wake word [#-the-wake-word]

1. Wake word listening is for owners, admins and adults only, and it is off until someone turns it on.
2. Look for the microphone button that says **Turn on wake word listening** in the message box. If it is missing, wake word is not set up on this house's Home, and no screen in Home sets it up. Ask the person who runs the house.
3. The only wake word is "Hey Jarvis". Allow the microphone in your browser, and keep the MaiPai page open.
4. A red bar that says "Listening for Hey Jarvis" shows while it is on. Tap **Turn off wake word listening** to stop it.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Admins can set voices: see [Settings reference](/docs/admin/install-and-set-up/settings-reference). Others, see [Still stuck](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck).

# Forget something (/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/forget-something)

Forgetting cannot be undone.

<Shot id="memory" />

## 💬 Delete a chat [#-delete-a-chat]

1. Open the chat.
2. Tap the menu at the top, **Conversation actions**.
3. Tap **Delete**.

## 🧠 Forget a memory [#-forget-a-memory]

1. Tap **Family**, then your own card.
2. Tap **Memories**.
3. Tap the archive-box button beside a memory. Or tap **Select memories**, tick some, and tap **Forget selected**.
4. To remove all of them, tap **Clear all**, then **Yes, forget all**. Choose **Keep them** to stop.

## 👶 Erase everything about a child [#-erase-everything-about-a-child]

Owners and admins only:

1. Open the child's profile and tap **Memories**.
2. Tap **Forget everything about** and the child's name.
3. Confirm with **Yes, forget everything**.

Before you erase, tap **Export** and the child's name first if you want a copy.

## 🔐 Teens and adults [#-teens-and-adults]

Only that person can forget their own memories. An admin cannot.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Ask the person who runs the house. Admins, see [Backups and restore](/docs/admin/look-after-it/backups-and-restore).


# What never leaves (/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/what-never-leaves)

{/* generated-source: docs/user/privacy.md */}

These stay on your computer:

- Your conversations.
- Everything MaiPai remembers.
- Every profile in your household.
- Anything your family says. It is never used to train anything.

## 🚫 What MaiPai does not collect [#-what-maipai-does-not-collect]

- No usage stats.
- No crash reports.

## 🌐 Your browser [#-your-browser]

Your browser saves MaiPai's own screens so the app can open without internet. It never stores what you typed or what MaiPai remembers.

## 🕶️ Temporary chats [#️-temporary-chats]

An owner, admin or adult can mark a chat as temporary. Its turns are not added to history or memory. If you open it again, the old turns do not return. This covers MaiPai on this computer only.

## 💛 A child's hard moment [#-a-childs-hard-moment]

The adults get a note with the child's name only, never what was said. It cannot be turned off.

## ✍️ Check it [#️-check-it]

1. Tap **Privacy**.
2. Read **What leaves your house**. It names every exception.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

See [What stays in the house](/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/what-stays-in-the-house), or ask the person who runs the house.


# What stays in the house (/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/what-stays-in-the-house)

Your conversations, memories and family profiles stay on the computer in your house. MaiPai does not run a server that your family's information passes through. Nothing reports back about how you use it.

## ✍️ See for yourself [#️-see-for-yourself]

1. Tap **Privacy** in the main menu.
2. Read the answers to "Can someone outside see what we say to MaiPai?" and "Can someone reach into your house?"
3. Open **What leaves your house** to see every connection.

For each connection you see **When** it happens, **What it sends**, **Who gets it** and **How long they keep it**. Anything not listed does not happen.

## 📨 What can leave [#-what-can-leave]

A feature can send the small piece it needs, such as your search words or the place for a weather check. A web search sends the words you searched, never your name or address. A child's or teen's search never goes to DuckDuckGo or Brave, and it follows the household **Search sources** choice.

## 🕶️ Temporary chats [#️-temporary-chats]

An owner, admin or adult can mark a chat as temporary. It is not saved to history or memory.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Not sure why a connection is listed? Ask the person who runs the house. Admins, see [Privacy audit](/docs/admin/look-after-it/privacy-audit).


# Find your way around (/docs/user/start-here/find-your-way-around)

The main menu runs down the left side on a computer. On a phone it stays as the same thin column of icons. It always has the same items.

<Shot id="main-menu-desktop" />

<Shot id="main-menu-phone" />

## 🧭 The main menu [#-the-main-menu]

- **Home**: counts for people, updates and repairs, and recent activity.
- **Chat**: talk to MaiPai. Your past chats are listed here too.
- **Library**: the files you and the family have added.
- **Family**: one card for each person. Tap a card to open that person's profile, where memories live.

Your own picture or initial sits at the bottom of the menu. Tap it to open your profile menu. It holds **Notifications**, **Incognito**, **Settings** and **Help**, and the way to sign out. Adults also see household settings under **Settings**. To see what stays in the house, read [What stays in the house](/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/what-stays-in-the-house).

The search box at the top finds chats, people and pages.

## 🔔 The bell [#-the-bell]

The bell shows new notices. See [See your notifications](/docs/user/everyday-use/see-your-notifications).

## ✍️ Steps to try it [#️-steps-to-try-it]

1. Tap **Chat** and start a new chat.
2. Tap **Family** and tap your own card.
3. Tap **Memories** to see what MaiPai remembers about you.
4. Tap **Settings** to see what you can change.

<Callout type="info">Some settings show a lock. A lock means an admin controls that one.</Callout>

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If a page will not open, see [If a page will not load](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/page-will-not-load).


# Install, upgrade, uninstall and fix the install (/docs/user/start-here/install-upgrade-uninstall)

## Before you start [#before-you-start]

Use the Mac itself. You need three things:

- A Mac with Apple silicon or Intel, and an internet connection.
- 3 GB of free disk space for Home. The installer checks this first.
- An account that can use `sudo` (an administrator).

The AI engine is a separate step that Home does for you later, inside the setup wizard, and only if this computer runs the AI. It needs 6 GB more to build, plus room for the AI models.

| Plan | Free space needed for the models |
|---|---|
| Recommended | 26 GB |
| Moderate | 19 GB |
| Minimal | 14 GB |

You do not need Homebrew. You do not need to install anything else first.

## Install [#install]

Open Terminal on the Mac and paste this one line. A plain SSH connection works too.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/getmaipai/home/main/scripts/install.sh | sudo bash
```

This installs Home only, so it takes about a minute. When Home answers, the installer prints the address to open, such as `http://localhost:3000`. Open it in a browser to start the setup wizard.

If it stops, read the last lines. They say what went wrong and what to do. Fix that, then run the same line again. It picks up where it stopped and does not hurt anything already installed.

## The AI engine installs from the wizard [#the-ai-engine-installs-from-the-wizard]

The wizard asks where the AI runs.

- **This computer.** Home starts the AI engine install right away. A progress bar at the bottom of the wizard shows each step: fetch, build and start, then the model downloads. You can keep answering questions while it works.
- **Another computer.** Nothing is installed on this one. You pair the other computer later.

The engine needs the Mac's logged-in desktop to use the graphics chip. If nobody is logged in at the Mac, the bar stops and says so. Log in at the Mac and press Try again.

If the bar stops for any reason, it says what went wrong. Fix that and press Try again. It picks up where it stopped. You can also run the engine step by hand.

```bash
sudo bash /usr/local/maipai-home/scripts/install.sh --stack-only
```

## What happens after a restart [#what-happens-after-a-restart]

MaiPai Home starts by itself when the Mac starts. No one needs to log in.

The AI engine starts when the Mac's user logs in. To make that automatic, turn on automatic login: open System Settings, then Users and Groups, then Automatic login. macOS only allows automatic login when FileVault is off. For a Mac that must come back by itself after a power cut, turn FileVault off. The trade: anyone who can touch the Mac can read its disk, so keep it somewhere safe. If you keep FileVault on, log in once at the Mac after a restart and the engine starts.

## Tune the Mac [#tune-the-mac]

A Mac that runs Home all day works best with a few settings changed. Setup shows them as a list. You can also run the tool yourself at the Mac. It changes nothing unless you add `--yes`.

```bash
bash /usr/local/maipai-home/scripts/studio/host-tune.sh detect
```

Two kinds of change are in the list.

- Changes inside Home's own folders. Home makes them for you. They keep Spotlight out of Home's files and keep the big AI models out of Time Machine. Home's data stays in your backups.
- Changes to the whole Mac. These need an administrator, so Home asks first. If Home cannot do one, it shows the exact line to paste in Terminal at the Mac. They stop the Mac from sleeping, turn it back on after a power cut, stop big macOS upgrades by themselves (security updates stay on), and turn on SSH. One more lets the graphics chip use more memory. You only need that one for very big AI models later.

Every change can be undone. Run the same line with `revert` and the name of the item.

```bash
sudo bash /usr/local/maipai-home/scripts/studio/host-tune.sh apply power --yes
sudo bash /usr/local/maipai-home/scripts/studio/host-tune.sh revert power --yes
```

Some things only you can do, so the list shows them as advice: leave iCloud, Siri and Apple Intelligence off for this account, turn the screen saver off, give the Mac a fixed address in your router, approve it in Tailscale, and install nothing extra except the Command Line Tools.

## Upgrade [#upgrade]

Run the same install line again. If the AI engine is already installed, it is rebuilt too, so the Mac must have someone logged in. It does these steps in order:

1. Stops MaiPai Home and the engine.
2. Saves a copy of your data in `/usr/local/maipai-home/upgrade-backups`. It keeps the last two copies.
3. Replaces the program files. Your data, backups and engine models stay where they are.
4. Starts everything again and waits until it answers.

Home keeps the same address it had before.

To install one exact version, add `--version` and the release name.

```bash
sudo bash /usr/local/maipai-home/scripts/install.sh --version v0.1.0
```

## Go back one version [#go-back-one-version]

If an upgrade does not work for you, go back.

```bash
sudo bash /usr/local/maipai-home/scripts/install.sh --rollback
```

This installs the version you had before. It also puts back the data copy from just before the upgrade. Your newer data is not thrown away. It is moved to a folder named `data.rolled-back-` and the date, next to the install.

## Uninstall [#uninstall]

```bash
sudo bash /usr/local/maipai-home/scripts/uninstall.sh
```

This stops and removes the services. Your data is kept unless you type `DELETE MY DATA` exactly when it asks. Any other answer keeps everything. Make a backup first if you are not sure.

## Where the logs are [#where-the-logs-are]

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| MaiPai Home | `/usr/local/maipai-home/data/logs/` |
| The AI engine | `/usr/local/maipai-home/stack/data/logs/` |

A daily job keeps each log file under about 20 MB. It keeps the last three older copies.

## Change a port [#change-a-port]

Home uses port 3000 and the engine uses port 8770. If something else already uses one, the installer picks the next free number. To choose your own, set it before the install line.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/getmaipai/home/main/scripts/install.sh | sudo MAIPAI_PORT=3100 MAIPAI_STACK_PORT=8780 bash
```

## Fix a problem [#fix-a-problem]

| What you see | What to do |
|---|---|
| The wizard bar says nobody is logged in at the Mac | Log in at the Mac, then press Try again in the wizard. |
| The wizard bar says the AI engine install stopped | Read the plain words on the bar, fix what they name, then press Try again. |
| "these tools are missing" | In Terminal run `xcode-select --install`, wait until it ends, then run the install line again. |
| "not enough free disk space" | Free up space, then run the install line again, or press Try again in the wizard. |
| "could not download" | Check the Mac's internet connection, then run the install line again. |
| macOS says it cannot verify a program | Open System Settings, then Privacy and Security, and choose Allow Anyway. Then run the install line again. |
| Home did not come up | Read the last lines of `/usr/local/maipai-home/data/logs/launchd.err.log`. Fix what they name, then run the install line again. |
| The engine does not answer after a restart | Log in at the Mac. The engine starts at login. |

If a run stops after it changed files, the last message tells you your data is safe. It also gives the rollback line.


# What MaiPai Home is (/docs/user/start-here/what-maipai-home-is)

MaiPai Home is an AI helper for your family. It runs on a computer in your house, so your chats, memories and family details stay there.

<Shot id="home" />

## 🏠 What you can do [#-what-you-can-do]

- Ask questions and get answers in a chat.
- Talk to it out loud instead of typing.
- Ask it to look something up and see where the answer came from.
- Let it remember things that help you, and see or erase them any time.

## 👨‍👩‍👧 Who uses it [#-who-uses-it]

Everyone in the house gets their own profile. A grown-up runs the house and decides what children can see. Teens and adults keep their own chats private.

## 🔒 What stays private [#-what-stays-private]

Your chats and memories are not sent to MaiPai or anyone else. A few features, like a web search, send only the small piece they need. The Privacy page lists each one. See [What stays in the house](/docs/user/privacy-and-safety/what-stays-in-the-house).

## 🧭 Where to go next [#-where-to-go-next]

1. Read [Your first minutes](/docs/user/start-here/your-first-minutes) to sign in and send a message.
2. Read [Find your way around](/docs/user/start-here/find-your-way-around) to learn the main menu.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Ask the person who runs the house, or see [If chat does not answer](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/chat-does-not-answer).


# Your first minutes (/docs/user/start-here/your-first-minutes)

<Shot id="sign-in-picker" />

<Shot id="sign-in-pin" />

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Open MaiPai Home in your web browser. Ask the person who runs the house for the address if you do not have it.
2. Pick your name from the list of people.
3. Under **Enter your PIN**, type your 4 digits. If you use a longer password, tap **Use a password instead**, type it in **Password**, then tap **Sign in**.
4. Tap **Chat** in the main menu.
5. Tap **New chat** if the page is not already empty.
6. Click the box that says **Send a message...** and type a question.
7. Press Enter, or tap the arrow button. The answer appears below your question.

<Shot id="chat-empty" />

<Callout type="info">Teens, children and guests may not need a PIN. Adults always do.</Callout>

## 🤔 If the first answer takes a while [#-if-the-first-answer-takes-a-while]

The first reply can be slow while MaiPai gets ready. You may see **Starting your AI…**. Wait a minute and it will answer.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

If your PIN is refused, see [If you cannot sign in](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/cannot-sign-in). If the first chat stays silent, see [If chat does not answer](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/chat-does-not-answer).


# Check in on a child (/docs/user/your-family/check-in-on-a-child)

This page is for owners and admins.

<Shot id="child-topics" />

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Tap **Family**, then the child's card. Their **Profile** opens.
2. On **Overview** you see shared files and the child's details.
3. Tap **Memories** to see what MaiPai remembers about them.
4. Tap **Limits** to set daily time limits and storage. The time limits are saved but not applied yet.
5. Tap **Topics** to choose how MaiPai answers them about sensitive subjects.

Only owners and admins see **Limits** and **Topics**.

## 💛 When a child has a hard moment [#-when-a-child-has-a-hard-moment]

If a conversation seems to weigh on a child, every adult gets a notice: "A check-in may help." It names the child but never says what was said. It cannot be turned off. Talk to the child, kindly and in person.

## 🔐 Teens are different [#-teens-are-different]

A teen's profile, memories and settings are private. A parent gets no check-in view of a teen.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Admins, see [Add people and parental controls](/docs/admin/people-and-safety/add-people-and-parental-controls). For anything else, see [Still stuck](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck).


# Sensitive subjects (/docs/user/your-family/sensitive-subjects)

This page is for owners and admins.

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Tap **Family**, then the child's card.
2. Tap the **Topics** tab.
3. Find the **Sensitive subjects** group.
4. Choose a level for each subject.
5. Your choice saves as you make it.

Only owners and admins can change these. The child cannot.

## 🛡️ What never changes [#️-what-never-changes]

Some things stay the same for every child:

- Feelings and safety come first. MaiPai points the child to a trusted grown-up.
- MaiPai never helps with bullying, secrets, or sharing where they live.
- It takes no side on religion or politics.
- If a child is in danger, it points to a grown-up and the emergency number.

## 🔐 Teens [#-teens]

There is no per-teen control. Household settings in **Settings**, **Privacy** apply to every teen. A teen's own settings are private.

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Admins, see [Safety settings](/docs/admin/people-and-safety/safety-settings). Otherwise see [Still stuck](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck).


# Sites and news a child sees (/docs/user/your-family/sites-and-news-a-child-sees)

This page is for owners and admins.

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Tap **Settings** and open the household settings for search.
2. Find **Blocked sites by person**.
3. Find the kind of site you want to change.
4. Tick or untick the box under **Kids**, **Teens** or **Adults**.
5. Your choice saves as you tick it.

Adult sites stay blocked for children and teens. Their boxes are greyed out and cannot be changed.

## 📰 News [#-news]

The news shelf has its own card where you choose which news sources show up. It sits beside the blocked sites card.

<Callout type="info">These lists are for the household. They do not read any chat.</Callout>

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Admins, see [Blocked sites and news feeds](/docs/admin/people-and-safety/blocked-sites-and-news-feeds). If a setting will not save, see [If a setting will not save](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/a-setting-will-not-save).


# What each role can do (/docs/user/your-family/what-each-role-can-do)

{/* generated-source: backend/src/lib/access.ts and frontend/src/apps/people/roles.ts */}

Every person has one role. It sets what they can do.

| Role | Sign-in | Can add people | Can see a child's profile | Temporary chats |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Owner** | PIN or password | Anyone, including admins | Yes | Yes |
| **Admin** | PIN or password | Adults, teens, children, guests | Yes | Yes |
| **Adult** | PIN or password | No | No | Yes |
| **Teen** | None needed | No | No | No |
| **Child** | None needed | No | No | No |
| **Guest** | None needed | No | No | No |

## 🔐 Private by design [#-private-by-design]

- Everyone can open their own profile and memories.
- An owner or admin can open a **child's** profile and memories. They cannot open a teen's or another adult's.
- A teen's chats and settings stay private from admins.

## 👶 Children [#-children]

Children's answers follow stricter settings. Only an owner or admin can change them. See [Sensitive subjects](/docs/user/your-family/sensitive-subjects).

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

To change someone's role, ask an admin. Admins, see [People, roles and permissions](/docs/admin/how-it-works/people-roles-and-permissions).


# Who is in the house (/docs/user/your-family/who-is-in-the-house)

## ✍️ Steps [#️-steps]

1. Tap **Family** in the main menu.
2. Stay on the **People** tab. Each person has one card with their name and role.
3. Tap a card to open that person's profile.

<Shot id="people" />

## 🏷️ The roles [#️-the-roles]

A role is a label that sets what a person may do: **Owner**, **Admin**, **Adult**, **Teen**, **Child** or **Guest**. See [What each role can do](/docs/user/your-family/what-each-role-can-do).

## 🐾 Other tabs [#-other-tabs]

Family may also show **Pets**. Owners and admins also see **Bots**.

## 🔐 What you can open [#-what-you-can-open]

You can always open your own profile. Owners and admins can also open a child's profile. Nobody can see a teen's or another adult's settings or memories, not even an admin. A teen's card in **Family** does not open for an admin, and typing the teen's address shows a message that the profile cannot be opened.

## ➕ Adding someone [#-adding-someone]

Only an admin can add a person. Admins, see [Add people and parental controls](/docs/admin/people-and-safety/add-people-and-parental-controls).

## 🙋 Still need help? [#-still-need-help]

Ask the person who runs the house, or see [Still stuck](/docs/user/fix-a-problem/still-stuck).
